cards.card: MTB Diamond / Signature / World Credit Card

note: Bangladesh's largest card issuers are private banks (City Bank, BRAC Bank, Eastern Bank among them); their current card schedules weren't found in this pass (BRAC Bank's found were from 2019 and 2023), so Bank Asia, whose schedule this file has held since 2026-10-29, is written alone. Bank Asia's credit card fees and charges (effective 1 March 2026, the file dated 14 July 2026, read again 2026-10-30): the primary card's annual fee by tier, 1,500 taka (Silver / Classic), 2,500 (Gold), 4,000 (Platinum / Titanium), 7,000 (Signature), 15,000 (World Elite), now written before the 15% VAT the schedule applies to all fees and charges, which is written as a tax on fees (until now this file wrote the Silver / Classic fee as 1,725 with the VAT folded in); interest 25% a year; a local cash advance 2.0% or 150 taka, whichever is higher; a late payment and a balance over the limit each 500, 700, 800, 1,000 or 1,200 taka by tier; spending in another currency a 3% markup. The 300-taka SMS alert fee (its period not stated), the US dollar international card fees and the Islamic card's maintenance fees aren't written. Excise duty is 'as per Govt. Policy', without a figure. No minimum payment or grace period is stated. Wave 4 (2026-10-30): Standard Chartered Bangladesh, among the largest card issuers, and Mutual Trust Bank, a large private card issuer, are added, both publishing current card schedules; City Bank's and BRAC Bank's home pages link no card schedule this research found, Dutch-Bangla's and Prime Bank's sites didn't answer, UCB's answers 403, and Eastern Bank's card schedule (effective 25 May 2026) is a single sheet in Bengali drawn as outlines, too small to read reliably by eye, so no EBL card is written (2026-10-30). Standard Chartered Bangladesh's credit card schedule of charges (August 2026, read 2026-10-30, its table checked by eye against the rendered page): the primary card's annual fee, Visa Silver (Classic) 1,500 taka, Visa Gold 3,000, the Simply Cash Card 5,000 standalone (3,500 as an add-on, not written), Visa Platinum and Assurance Card 5,000, the Smart Card 3,000, Visa Signature 12,000, and the Visa International Platinum 105 US dollars; finance charges 25% a year; the minimum amount due 1% of the principal outstanding plus all fees, charges and instalments, at least 500 taka (on the dollar card 1% or 10 dollars, whichever is higher), written as 1% with that floor; at most 45 days free of interest when the balance is paid in full; a late payment 450, 600, 750, 1,000 and 1,000 taka by card (15 dollars); over the limit 1,000 or 1,500 taka (15 dollars); a cash advance 2.5% (at least 5 dollars on the dollar card); a returned cheque 50 taka; international transactions 3%; 15% VAT on charges, written as a tax on fees. Mutual Trust Bank's schedule of charges for its conventional credit cards (effective 15 October 2026, read 2026-10-30): the primary card's annual fee, Classic 1,500 taka, Gold 3,000, Platinum or Titanium 6,000, Diamond, Signature or World 12,000, FC Signature 100 US dollars (its waiver by reward points isn't written); interest 25% a year; a late payment 1,000, 1,000, 1,200 and 1,200 taka (10 dollars); over the limit 1,000 or 1,500 taka (15 dollars); a cash advance 3% (none on the FC Signature); a markup of 3% on spending in a foreign currency other than the US dollar. VAT is charged 'as per Govt. rules', without a figure, and isn't written; nor are the SMS and protection-plan fees. No minimum payment or grace period is stated.
